meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Now, what is the zero based on?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
"Like, being stuck" isn't a wrong answer from a seventeen-year-old put on the spot. Show me the note you wrote.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between the outline and the essay; that's the point of an outline. You still haven't shown me the note, so put it and the outline on the table.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.
That's your own 4.4, and I'll hold you to the writing. But a rewrite for what? I still haven't seen one document, and taking that offer now admits something.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you offered Owen a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still expect the zero withdrawn, and I want to see the note you say you wrote and the outline you described before Owen agrees to anything. You committed to putting the offer in writing by Friday at 3 PM, and I expect it by then.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her fallback position. She accepted that your rewrite offer would keep this off his record, but she agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and your documents in front of her; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and your offer matched it, but she couldn't take it without evidence, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home, in one sentence, and moved on, which took away her strongest procedural attack.
What cost ground: You described your November 2 conversation and the October 15 outline but never showed either, even after she asked for the note, so she had nothing she could check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on the November 2 conversation and the October 15 outline and never came near a late night in October; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked to see the note from November 2, put it on the table with its date before moving to the outline or making the rewrite offer.
